hero.notes: Warm, gravelly dwarven baritone with a soft Scots lilt; gruff but kind, short sentences.

lantern.notes: Small, bright, crackly voice of a fire-spirit; quick and chatty, gets squeaky when scared.

sfxStyle: Crunchy pick-on-ice hits, tinkling icicles, crackling lantern flame, creaking timbers, breathy whooshes and soft chimes for spirits, all with cavernous reverb.

musicMoods.explore: Sparse music-box and celesta over low cello drone, distant wind, 70 bpm, loopable
musicMoods.combat: Driving frame drums and plucked strings with icy glass textures, 120 bpm, loopable
musicMoods.victory: Warm brass-and-fiddle dwarven folk sting with a hearthfire crackle tail
